## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle structural-outline (*kē* 科) of **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānfán bǔquē xíngshì chāo* 四分律刪繁補闕行事鈔 ([KR6k0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0017)) by **Yuánzhào** 元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116), the Northern Sòng *Língzhīsì* 靈芝寺 *Nánshānlǜ* revivalist. Author signature: *餘杭郡沙門釋　元照　錄* (*Recorded by Yuánzhào, monk of Yúháng commandery*). The *kē* serves as the structural index for Yuánzhào's principal substantive sub-commentary on the *Xíngshì chāo*, the *Zīchí jì* 資持記 (in the Manji canon as X41 etc.).

**Abstract**

The *Kē* is the structural counterpart to Yuánzhào's *Zīchí jì* on the *Xíngshì chāo*; together with the *Kē* on the *Suíjī jiémó shū* ([KR6k0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0157)) and the *Kē* on the *Hánzhù jièběn shū* (in [KR6k0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0144)), it forms the late-eleventh-century *Língzhīsì* programme of structural-philological work on Dàoxuān's three principal *Sìfēnlǜ* commentaries. These structural outlines became the dominant pedagogical tool for the Sòng-period *Lǜzōng* and were exported to Japan and Korea as part of the Sòng Vinaya curriculum. Composition belongs to Yuánzhào's mature period (post-1075).
